robust.zh: 穩固的、可靠的（系統、設計）

ex.en: We need a more robust security system.
ex.zh: 我們需要更可靠的安全系統。

ex.en: The software is robust and easy to use.
ex.zh: 這套軟體穩定又好用。

ex.en: The economy showed robust growth last year.
ex.zh: 去年經濟呈現強勁成長。

ex.en: Demand for our products remains robust.
ex.zh: 我們產品的需求依然強勁。

ex.en: Full oxidation gives black tea its deep, robust flavor and dark amber color.
ex.zh: 完全氧化讓紅茶有濃郁醇厚的風味和深琥珀色。

ex.en: This wine has a robust flavor.
ex.zh: 這款紅酒風味濃郁。

ex.en: The rocket was launched into space.
ex.zh: 火箭被發射到太空。

ex.en: The rocket travels at a tremendous speed.
ex.zh: 火箭飛行的速度極快。

rocket.zh: rocket science：（多用於否定）高深的學問、難事

ex.en: Connecting a PC to the internet isn't rocket science.
ex.zh: 把電腦連上網路又不是什麼難事。

ex.en: Don't worry, it's not rocket science.
ex.zh: 別擔心，這又不是什麼高深的學問。

ex.en: Housing prices have rocketed in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來房價飆升。

ex.en: Sales rocketed after the ad campaign.
ex.zh: 廣告活動之後銷售量暴增。

ex.en: The robot went out of control.
ex.zh: 這個機器人失控了。

ex.en: In the future, will robots be as common as personal computers?
ex.zh: 未來，機器人會像個人電腦一樣普及嗎？

ex.en: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.
ex.zh: 每個機器人身上都裝了一台發聲器。

ex.en: Intel gets a huge royalty from the invention.
ex.zh: 英特爾從那項發明中獲得一大筆權利金。

ex.en: The author receives royalties on every book sold.
ex.zh: 每賣出一本書，作者都能拿到版稅。

ex.en: The hotel has hosted royalty and movie stars.
ex.zh: 這家飯店接待過皇室成員和電影明星。

ex.en: We were treated like royalty at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上受到貴賓級的款待。

ex.en: We routinely check all equipment for safety.
ex.zh: 我們例行檢查所有設備的安全。

ex.en: Staff routinely work late on Fridays.
ex.zh: 員工星期五經常加班到很晚。

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 你們有便宜一點的房間嗎？

ex.en: Do you have any rooms with a shower and toilet?
ex.zh: 有附淋浴和馬桶的房間嗎？

ex.en: Is there room for one more person?
ex.zh: 還有空間再多坐一個人嗎？

ex.en: This sofa takes up too much room.
ex.zh: 這張沙發太佔空間了。

ex.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.
ex.zh: 大自然在我們的生活中扮演重要的角色。

ex.en: My role is to manage the team's schedule.
ex.zh: 我的職責是管理團隊的行程。

ex.en: Social media plays a big role in marketing.
ex.zh: 社群媒體在行銷上扮演重要角色。

ex.en: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
ex.zh: 下次校慶時，他將第一次擔任主角。

ex.en: She got the main role in the school play.
ex.zh: 她在學校話劇中拿到主角。

ex.en: The glass from a round table has been smashed.
ex.zh: 一張圓桌的玻璃被打碎了。

ex.en: We sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 我們坐在一張圓桌旁。

round.zh: all year round：一年到頭、終年

ex.en: This mountain is covered with snow all year round.
ex.zh: 這座山終年積雪。

ex.en: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.
ex.zh: 台灣的森林終年常綠。

ex.en: We can enjoy skiing here all the year round.
ex.zh: 我們在這裡一整年都能滑雪。

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們給表演者一陣掌聲。

ex.en: The candidates passed the first round of interviews.
ex.zh: 候選人通過了第一輪面試。

ex.en: This round of drinks is on me.
ex.zh: 這一輪酒我請客。

ex.en: Please round the number to two decimal places.
ex.zh: 請把數字四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

ex.en: The price was rounded up to 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格被進位到一百元。

ex.en: This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路太窄，車子過不去。

ex.en: Look out for cars when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 過馬路時要小心車子。

ex.en: There are a lot of long and straight roads in Hokkaido.
ex.zh: 北海道有很多又長又直的路。

road.zh: on the road：在路上；在外奔波（出差）

ex.en: Our sales team is on the road most of the month.
ex.zh: 我們的業務團隊一個月大半時間都在外奔波。

ex.en: We've been on the road for six hours.
ex.zh: 我們已經在路上開了六個小時的車。

ex.en: The rocks are weathered into fantastic forms.
ex.zh: 岩石經過風化，形成了奇特的形狀。

ex.en: Don't throw rocks into the river.
ex.zh: 不要往河裡丟石頭。

ex.en: The woman is in front of a big rock.
ex.zh: 那個女人站在一塊大石頭前面。

ex.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
ex.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂和爵士樂的結合。

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

ex.en: She rocked the baby to sleep.
ex.zh: 她搖著寶寶哄他入睡。

ex.en: The boat rocked gently on the waves.
ex.zh: 船在浪上輕輕搖晃。

ex.en: The children rolled down the hill.
ex.zh: 孩子們從山坡上滾下來。

ex.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
ex.zh: 「滾石不生苔」是一句諺語。

ex.en: The ball rolled under the car.
ex.zh: 球滾到車子底下了。

ex.en: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?
ex.zh: 你午餐想吃小餐包嗎？

ex.en: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?
ex.zh: 你知道春捲為什麼叫春捲嗎？

ex.en: We need another roll of toilet paper.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一捲衛生紙。

ex.en: The company will roll out the new app next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月將推出新 App。

ex.en: The update is being rolled out to all users.
ex.zh: 這次更新正陸續推送給所有使用者。

ex.en: Pull the plant up by the roots.
ex.zh: 把植物連根拔起。

ex.en: The tree's roots go deep into the ground.
ex.zh: 這棵樹的根深入地底。

ex.en: We must get to the root of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們必須找出問題的根源。

ex.en: Poor communication is the root of the problem.
ex.zh: 溝通不良是問題的根源。

root.zh: 根、淵源（複數，如家族、文化的起源）

ex.en: She went back to Taiwan to find her roots.
ex.zh: 她回台灣尋根。

ex.en: Jazz has its roots in African American music.
ex.zh: 爵士樂起源於非裔美國人的音樂。

ex.en: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
ex.zh: 生肖文化深深根植於人們的日常生活和語言文化中。

ex.en: The tradition is deeply rooted in local culture.
ex.zh: 這項傳統深植於當地文化。

ex.en: Tom always wants to sit in the front row.
ex.zh: 湯姆總是想坐在第一排。

ex.en: The charge for a front row seat is 5 dollars.
ex.zh: 第一排的座位要五美元。

ex.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把 CD 在架子上排成一排。

ex.en: It has rained for five days in a row.
ex.zh: 已經連續下了五天的雨。

ex.en: Our team won three games in a row.
ex.zh: 我們隊連贏了三場比賽。

ex.en: Let's take turns rowing the boat.
ex.zh: 我們輪流划船吧。

ex.en: We rowed up the river against the current.
ex.zh: 我們在河上逆流划船而上。

ex.en: Tom fixed the roof of his house just yesterday.
ex.zh: 湯姆昨天才修好他家的屋頂。

ex.en: There is a lot of snow on the roof.
ex.zh: 屋頂上積了很多雪。

ex.en: That house with the red roof is Tom's house.
ex.zh: 那棟紅色屋頂的房子是湯姆家。

ex.en: Ten years after the wedding, everything is just routine.
ex.zh: 結婚十年後，一切都只是例行公事。

ex.en: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
ex.zh: 運動是我每天的例行公事。

ex.en: Such questioning is routine police business.
ex.zh: 這樣的訊問只是警方的例行公事。

ex.en: This is just a routine check.
ex.zh: 這只是例行檢查。

ex.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
ex.zh: 這個物體的表面相當粗糙。

ex.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
ex.zh: 鯊魚皮比鮪魚皮粗糙多了。

ex.en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
ex.zh: 粗略估計，這份工作大概要兩個星期。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough idea of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我大概要多少錢嗎？

ex.en: I had a rough day at work.
ex.zh: 我今天上班很不順。

ex.en: The company went through a rough year.
ex.zh: 公司度過了艱困的一年。

ex.en: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
ex.zh: 亞洲面積大約是歐洲的四倍。

ex.en: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.
ex.zh: 我的中文還差得遠，但他說的話我大致都聽得懂。

ex.en: The trip takes roughly two hours.
ex.zh: 這趟路程大約兩個小時。

ex.en: Please don't handle the boxes roughly.
ex.zh: 請不要粗魯地搬這些箱子。

ex.en: He pushed the door open roughly.
ex.zh: 他粗暴地把門推開。

ex.en: Mary is always saying that Tom isn't romantic enough.
ex.zh: 瑪麗總是說湯姆不夠浪漫。

ex.en: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
ex.zh: 他是個很浪漫的男朋友，每晚都送花給我。

ex.en: Actually I find it quite romantic.
ex.zh: 其實我覺得那很浪漫。

ex.en: They have a romantic relationship.
ex.zh: 他們是戀愛關係。

ex.en: I prefer romantic comedies to action movies.
ex.zh: 比起動作片，我比較喜歡浪漫喜劇。

ex.en: Kate has become a full member of the royal family.
ex.zh: 凱特已正式成為王室成員。

ex.en: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
ex.zh: 蘇在皇家飯店辦理入住。

ex.en: Millions of people watched the royal wedding.
ex.zh: 數百萬人收看了這場皇室婚禮。

ex.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
ex.zh: 女孩送我一朵紅玫瑰和一朵白玫瑰。

ex.en: The roses in the garden are in flower.
ex.zh: 花園裡的玫瑰正盛開。

ex.en: There is no such thing as a thornless rose.
ex.zh: 沒有不帶刺的玫瑰。

rose.zh: rise 的過去式：上升、上漲；起身

ex.en: Today, the temperature rose as high as 30 degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 今天氣溫升到攝氏三十度。

ex.en: Sales rose by 15 percent last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季銷售額成長了百分之十五。

ex.en: The rope broke when we were climbing the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們爬山的時候繩子斷了。

ex.en: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.
ex.zh: 繩子不夠牢固，撐不住他。

ex.en: Tom untied the ropes.
ex.zh: 湯姆解開了繩子。

rope.zh: learn/know the ropes：熟悉門道、上手

ex.en: It took me a month to learn the ropes at my new job.
ex.zh: 我花了一個月才熟悉新工作。

ex.en: Amy will show you the ropes on your first day.
ex.zh: 你第一天上班時，Amy 會教你怎麼做。

ex.en: My manager roped me into organizing the party.
ex.zh: 我主管硬拉我去籌辦派對。

ex.en: We roped in some volunteers to help.
ex.zh: 我們找了一些志工來幫忙。

ex.en: The earth rotates once every 24 hours.
ex.zh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一圈。

ex.en: Rotate the image 90 degrees to the right.
ex.zh: 把圖片向右旋轉九十度。

ex.en: We rotate the night shift every week.
ex.zh: 我們每週輪流值夜班。

ex.en: New staff rotate between departments to gain experience.
ex.zh: 新進員工在各部門輪調以累積經驗。

ex.en: The rotation of the earth causes day and night.
ex.zh: 地球自轉造成日夜交替。

ex.en: One full rotation takes about 24 hours.
ex.zh: 自轉一整圈大約需要二十四小時。

ex.en: The nurses work in rotation.
ex.zh: 護理師們輪班工作。

ex.en: Crop rotation keeps the soil healthy.
ex.zh: 輪作能讓土壤保持健康。

ex.en: What is the most convenient route to your place?
ex.zh: 到您那裡哪條路線最方便？

ex.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
ex.zh: 不管你選哪條路，你都能按時到那裡。

ex.en: Luckily, we found an escape route.
ex.zh: 幸好我們找到了一條逃生路線。

ex.en: The supervisor posted next month’s shift roster in the staff room.
ex.zh: 主管把下個月的輪班表貼在員工休息室。

ex.en: Two nurses swapped shifts, so the roster needs an update.
ex.zh: 兩位護理師調換了班，值班表需要更新。

ex.en: The product roadmap shows which features will be released in each quarter.
ex.zh: 產品發展藍圖列出各項功能預計在哪一季推出。

ex.en: The board asked for a clear roadmap for reducing operating costs.
ex.zh: 董事會要求提出明確的營運成本降低計畫。

ex.en: The university offers a course in robotics.
ex.zh: 這所大學開設機器人技術課程。

ex.en: Robotics is changing the way factories operate.
ex.zh: 機器人技術正在改變工廠的運作方式。

ex.en: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
ex.zh: 如何使用路由器限制網路速度？

ex.en: The router needs a firmware update.
ex.zh: 這台路由器需要更新韌體。

ex.en: Roadwork near the station will continue through Friday.
ex.zh: 車站附近的道路施工將持續到週五。

ex.en: Allow extra travel time because of overnight roadwork.
ex.zh: 夜間道路施工，請預留較多交通時間。

ex.en: My roommate and I split the utility bills every month.
ex.zh: 我和室友每月分攤水電費。

ex.en: Her new roommate works at the hospital nearby.
ex.zh: 她的新室友在附近的醫院工作。

ex.en: We ordered room service because we were too tired to go out.
ex.zh: 我們太累了不想出門，所以叫了客房服務。

ex.en: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 客房服務 24 小時提供。

ex.en: Please give me a round-trip ticket to Chicago.
ex.zh: 請給我一張到芝加哥的來回票。

ex.en: Did you buy a round-trip ticket?
ex.zh: 你買了來回票嗎？

ex.en: What's the round-trip fare?
ex.zh: 來回票多少錢？

ex.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
ex.zh: 在圓環走第二個出口。

ex.en: There's a roundabout just after the bridge.
ex.zh: 過橋後馬上有一個圓環。

ex.en: He asked in a roundabout way whether I was single.
ex.zh: 他拐彎抹角地問我是不是單身。

ex.en: Don't be so roundabout. Just tell me.
ex.zh: 別拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我吧。
